nodes.description: No disease-specific therapy is approved. nodes.description: Biallelic MAK variants remove MAK kinase function in photoreceptors. The exon 9 Alu insertion prevents the developmental switch to the retinal MAK transcript, so patient cells lack wild-type exon 9-containing transcript; nonsense, frameshift and splice-site variants are predicted null alleles; and two kinase-domain missense variants abolish kinase activity in vitro. MAK is a cilium-associated serine/threonine kinase expressed in rod and cone photoreceptors and in testis; it phosphorylates the N-terminal region of the axonemal microtubule-associated protein RP1 in mouse photoreceptor cilia.
